title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are you well-versed in the iCloud?
That was to my brother Greg
Somewhat. I’ve tried syncing my contacts from my phone to my computer and it doesn’t work. I’ve been in forums and nothing gives. So I know enough, but not a lot
I seem to have lost a chunk of my voice memos. I’m guessing I probably accidentally deleted them while moving files when I got my new computer
I figured I moved them from phone to CPU, but they’re nowhere to be found. It says I’m backing up voice memos and I don’t ever remember changing it, but i can’t figure it out
Don’t know what the answer is yet, but take a guess at how many total hours of John Lowe conversations I”ve kept over the years
I haven’t tallied anything up yet, but he’s got like 3-4 files every year and we usually talk long
